mapper.select: SELECT RECRUIT_EXAM_NO , PROCESS_NO , RECRUIT_EXAM_NAME , RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE , RECRUIT_EXAM_START_DATE , RECRUIT_EXAM_END_DATE FROM RECRUITMENT_EXAM
SELECT RECRUIT_EXAM_NO , PROCESS_NO , RECRUIT_EXAM_NAME , RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE , RECRUIT_EXAM_START_DATE , RECRUIT_EXAM_END_DATE FROM RECRUITMENT_EXAM WHERE RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = #{recruitExamNo}

SELECT e.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO AS recruitExamNo, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_NAME AS recruitExamName, TO_CHAR(e.RECRUIT_EXAM_START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS recruitExamStartDate, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_TIME AS recruitExamTime, a.APPLICANT_ID AS applicantId,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPLICANT_ANSWER aa WHERE aa.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID AND aa.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = e.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS taken FROM APPLICANT a JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS p ON a.RECRUITMENT_NO = p.RECRUITMENT_NO AND p.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE = 'RERP-001' AND p.RECRUIT_PROCESS_DEL_DATE IS NULL JOIN RECRUITMENT_EXAM e ON p.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = e.PROCESS_NO AND e.RECRUIT_EXAM_DEL_DATE IS NULL WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE IS NULL ORDER BY e.RECRUIT_EXAM_START_DATE

SELECT q.RECRUIT_EXAM_QUEST_NO AS recruitExamQuestNo, q.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO AS recruitExamNo, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_NAME AS recruitExamName, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_CUTLINE AS recruitExamCutLine, e.RECRUIT_EXAM_TIME AS recruitExamTime, q.RECRUIT_EXAM_QUEST_CONTENT AS recruitExamQuestContent, o.RECRUIT_OPTION_NO AS recruitOptionNo, o.RECRUIT_EXAM_OPTION_CONTENT AS recruitExamOptionContent FROM RECRUITMENT_EXAM_QUESTIONS q JOIN RECRUITMENT_EXAM e ON q.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = e.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO JOIN RECRUITMENT_EXAM_OPTION o ON q.RECRUIT_EXAM_QUEST_NO = o.RECRUIT_EXAM_QUEST_NO WHERE q.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = #{recruitExamNo} ORDER BY q.RECRUIT_EXAM_QUEST_NO, o.RECRUIT_OPTION_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE APPLICANT_RECORD SET STEP_APPLICATION_YN = 'Y' WHERE RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = (SELECT PROCESS_NO FROM RECRUITMENT_EXAM WHERE RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = #{recruitExamNo}) AND APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId}
